top_signals.title: How GTA VI Became the Most Expensive Video Game Ever Made
top_signals.summary: It took over a decade to make Grand Theft Auto VI. And when it’s released on November 19, it will have likely already set at least one record: the most expensive video game ever made. In the years since the last GTA release, the video game industry has changed massively. Investors, once excited by the prospect of blockbuster video games, have pulled back, sales have stagnated, and the industry as a whole seems more precarious.
